title: List Of Documents Found At The Home Of Liu Ying Who Was Assassinated

page_data.en:
Copy for S.B. (Special Branch)

2115/40.
2

HONGKONG POLICE
REGISTRY
397
28 - 9 40

ac"
Hongkong
Sept. 17th 40.
1.

Further to Diary 1, on the 16/9/40 an inquest was held at the Public Mortuary on the body of deceased Procurator Tong King San handing down the following verdict:-

Death due to gun shot wound, body to be removed by deceased's wife.

Enquiries have been continued in the vicinity of this crime but no useful information has so far been obtained.

As a result of representations made by major Hayashi 1/c Japanese Gendarmerie through the offices of the Japanese Affairs Bureau, the books and documents seized by the undersigned from deceased's room and forwarded to Special Branch, Headquarters for examination were handed over to Major Hayashi on the 16/9/40 per instructions issued by the D.C.(Crime).

From the nature of the documents found in deceased room, it now becomes apparent that this crime has been politically motivated.

Attached is a copy of the documents seized from deceased's home.

Enquiries proceeding.

（签名）
Sen.Det.1/c.

W.J. Smith
D.S.I.

（左侧手写批注及印章）
S.
(p/a)
（印：ED BY REGISTRY 9/40）

香港警察

397
1940年9月28日

ac"
香港
1940年9月17日。
1.

继日记第1条之后，于1940年9月16日在公众殓房对死者检察官唐景山（Tong King San）的尸体进行了死因研讯，裁定如下：-

死因为枪伤，尸体由死者妻子领回。

已在案发地附近继续进行调查，但迄今未获得有用信息。

经日本宪兵队林少校（Major Hayashi）通过日本事务局办事处提出交涉，根据刑事侦缉处处长（D.C.(Crime)）发出的指示，本人从死者房间查获并送往总部特别处审查的书籍和文件，已于1940年9月16日移交给林少校。

从在死者房间发现的文件性质来看，现在显然可以看出这起犯罪是出于政治动机。

附件为从死者家中查获的文件副本。

调查正在进行中。

（签名）
高级警探长（Sen.Det.1/c）。

W.J. Smith
副督察（D.S.I.）

（左侧手写批注及印章）
S.
(p/a)
（印：ED BY REGISTRY 9/40）

page_data.en:
List of documents found at the home of LI HUNG TO (刘英),
who was assassinated on September 17, 1940 at Lane 330,
House 6, Joochang Road.

1. Political Intelligence reports - spare copies for
the months of July, August, September, October,
November and December, 1939 and also for the
months of January, February, March, April, May
June and July, 1940.

2. Seven books containing a variety of intelligence
reports, mostly of the Secret Service of the National
Government at Chungking and its activities in Shanghai.

3. Two bundles of loose sheets - intelligence.

4. Seven exercise books containing a large quantity of
newspaper clippings.

5. Two books containing general intelligence.

6. One paper folder containing a certificate issued to
Liu King on 12/8/the 15th year of the Emperor Shao Woo
of Japan, by the Japanese Military Authorities.

7. One small note book containing names, addresses and
telephone numbers of different persons.

8. Seven bundles of drafts - intelligence.

9. One note book containing the local addresses of important
personnel and high officials of the National Government
at Chungking.

10. 31 sheets of typewritten paper (in French), mostly on
the following subjects:-
a) The attempted assassination of M. Blanchet, Acting
Commissioner of the French Police.
b) M. Auge, local Consul-General for France, dismissed
by the Vichy Government.
c) Adoption of precautionary measures in the French
Concession.
d) Anti-British Movement to be commenced in the French
Concession.
e) Political Plain Clothes Squads to be organized by
the Political Section of the French Police.

11. One certificate issued on August 12, the 15th year of
the Emperor Shao Woo of Japan to one LI HUNG DOO (李宏圖),
aged 27, residing in the Che Yung University, Wangkashaw
Gardens, (Intelligence Worker) by the Japanese Military
Authorities.

12. Day to day record on the political situation in China
from January 1, 1940 to June 30, 1940.

13. A bundle of drafts, miscellaneous papers, name cards,
invitation cards, etc.

14. One envelop containing $30.00 in legal tender notes.

.......................
page_data.zh:
在刘英（LI HUNG TO）家中发现的文件清单，
刘英于1940年9月17日在兆丰路（Joochang Road）330弄6号被暗杀。

1. 政治情报报告——1939年7月、8月、9月、10月、
11月和12月的备用副本，以及1940年1月、2月、3月、4月、5月、
6月和7月的备用副本。

2. 七本书籍，包含各种情报报告，主要是关于重庆国民政府
秘密服务机构及其在上海的活动。

3. 两捆散页——情报资料。

4. 七个练习本，包含大量剪报。

5. 两本书籍，包含一般情报。

6. 一个纸质文件夹，内含一份由日本军方当局于日本昭和天皇
十五年（即1940年）8月12日签发给刘京（Liu King）的证书。

7. 一个小笔记本，记录不同人员的姓名、地址和电话号码。

8. 七捆草稿——情报资料。

9. 一个笔记本，包含重庆国民政府重要人员
和高级官员的本地地址。

10. 31页打字纸（法文），主要涉及以下主题：-
a) 法国代理警务总监布兰切特先生（M. Blanchet）遇刺未遂案。
b) 法国驻沪总领事奥热先生（M. Auge）被维希政府解职。
c) 在法租界采取预防措施。
d) 将在法租界发起的反英运动。
e) 由法国警务处政治科组建的政治便衣队。

11. 一份由日本军方当局于日本昭和天皇十五年（即1940年）8月12日
签发给李宏圖（LI HUNG DOO）的证书，李宏圖，27岁，
居住在王家沙花园（Wangkashaw Gardens）之江大学（Che Yung University），
（情报工作人员）。

12. 1940年1月1日至1940年6月30日中国政治局势的逐日记录。

13. 一捆草稿、杂项文件、名片、请柬等。

14. 一个信封，内合法币30.00元。

.......................

page_data.en:
At 9.16 a.m. 15/9/40, a telephone message was
received from C.C.R. to the effect that the S.F.B.
Ambulance had been called to House 6, Lane 360 Woochang
Road, a person having been injured in a shooting affray.
Upon receipt of the message, the undersigned,
D.P.S. Tanaka, C.D.S. 134 and C.D.C.61 attended and from
subsequent enquiries made the following facts were
ascertained:-
The locus of the shooting is a Chinese styled
dwelling, located in the last sub-alleyway of Lane 360,
Woochang Road, the said alleyway forming the end of a
cul-de-sac.
Entry to these premises in which several families
reside, can be gained either via a front or rear door,
however families residing in the upper part of the
premises invariably use the back door, which in consequence
is kept open during the day, allowing free access to the
tenants and their friend and in this case, the murderer.
The now deceased, together with his wife and
mother-in-law occupied a small upstair front room, whilst
a small adjoining room constructed by means of wooden
partitions is occupied by his amah one named Wong Ah
Kying (王阿金).
Upon the entry of the Police party into the room
occupied by deceased, said person was found laying
outstretched on his back in a pool of blood upon the
floor, obviously dead his wife sitting on the floor beside
him, whilst his mother-in-law and amah were located by the
room entrance.
The S.F.B. Ambulance was summoned and removed the
deceased to the Shanghai Sanitarium Range Road where he was
pronounced "Dead on arrival" suffering from bullet wounds.
page_data.zh:
1940年9月15日上午9:16，收到中央无线电室（C.C.R.）的电话留言，称
上海消防局（S.F.B.）救护车已被召往武昌路360弄6号，
有一人在枪击事件中受伤。
收到消息后，本人、巡捕谭中（D.P.S. Tanaka）、华籍侦探副巡长134号（C.D.S. 134）和华籍侦探巡长61号（C.D.C.61）前往现场，经后续调查查明以下事实：-
枪击发生地为一座中式住宅，位于武昌路360弄最后一条支弄内，该支弄构成一条死胡同的尽头。
进入这栋居住着几户人家的房屋，可以通过前门或后门，然而居住在上层的住户 invariably 使用后门，因此后门在白天一直敞开，方便租户及其朋友出入，本案中凶手也由此进入。
现已故世的死者与其妻子和岳母占用楼上的一间小前屋，而一间用木板隔断搭建的相邻小房间由其佣人王阿金（Wong Ah Kying）居住。
当警方进入死者房间时，发现死者仰面躺在地板上的血泊中，显然已死亡，其妻子坐在他身旁的地板上，而其岳母和佣人则位于房间入口处。
上海消防局（S.F.B.）救护车被召来，将死者送往雷士德路（Range Road）上海疗养院，在那里他被宣布“到达时已死亡”，死因为枪伤。

page_data.en:
An examination of deceased's body showed same
to bear two bullet holes in the face an entry hole being
behind the lobe of the left ear, and a slightly larger
hole (exit) slightly above the right cheek bone, no
other wounds were visible, though powder burns were
found on the left ear and cheek showing that the murderer
had placed his pistol close to deceased's face. The
deceased's room and contents of same was later thoroughly
searched by detectives, this resulting in the finding of
a spent revolver bullet, presumably of .38 calibre
imbedded in the pillow on which the deceased was resting
his head when shot, whilst located in a number of drawers
and cupboards a large quantity of books and papers
dealing with Political activities were found, these being
subsequently brought to Hongkew Station and later handed
over to Special Branch Headquarters by C.D.I. Telfer,
whilst the spent bullet was later also taken to the Arms
Identification Section for examination and comparison
with bullets etc. at present on file at that Bureau.

Enquiries continued at the scene of this crime
have ascertained that at about 9.10 a.m. 15/9/40, a male
Chinese as described on Sheet 1 of this report carrying
fruit and moon cakes entered the stated premises via the
open back door and ascended the stair-case leading
to the upper story of his dwelling where-in deceased's
room is located, the door of which was partially open,
the deceased being asleep in bed together with his wife.

En-route to the deceased's room, the murderer
had to pass the small room occupied by the amah, and
she, through the open door perceiving the murderer passing
asked him whom he wished to see, receiving a reply to
the effect, is the "Sien Sang" home ? coincident with which
page_data.zh:
对死者尸体的检查显示，面部有两个弹孔，一个入口孔位于左耳垂后方，另一个稍大的孔（出口）位于右颧骨上方稍高处，未见其他伤口，但在左耳和脸颊上发现火药灼伤痕迹，表明凶手将手枪贴近死者面部。随后侦探对死者房间及其内容物进行了彻底搜查，结果在死者中枪时头部倚靠的枕头中发现一枚已发射的左轮子弹，推测口径为.38，同时在多个抽屉和橱柜中发现了大量涉及政治活动的书籍和文件，这些物品随后由华籍侦探副巡长泰尔弗（C.D.I. Telfer）带至虹口捕房，后移交至特别处总部，而那枚已发射的子弹随后也被送至武器鉴定科进行检查，并与该局存档的子弹等进行比对。

在案发地继续进行的调查查明，大约在1940年9月15日上午9:10，一名如本报告第1页所述的中国男性，携带水果和月饼，通过后门进入上述住所，并登上通往住宅上层的楼梯，死者房间即位于上层，房门半开，死者正与妻子一起在床上睡觉。

在前往死者房间的途中，凶手必须经过佣人居住的小房间，她透过敞开的门看到凶手经过，便问他找谁，得到的回答大意是：“先生在家吗？”与此同时

page_data.en:
reply the murderer entered deceased's room followed by
the amah, who stated that she would awaken her master,
being how-ever prevented from so doing by the now abs-
conded murderer, who stated that he himself would awaken
him.

Immediately upon entering the room, the murderer
placed his gifts of fruit and cake upon the table and
then proceeded to the head of the bed ostensibly to
awaken the sleeping occupants, but upon reaching the bed
without awakening them, the murderer suddenly produced a
revolver from his long gown placed same against the left
ear of the deceased, who was laying on his right side
and fired one shot into his head, afterwards hurriedly
decamping from the room, making good his escape via the
point of entry.

No attempt was made by the amah Ah Kying (阿金)
to stop the murderer, she however chased him down the
stairs and into the alleyway, noticing that he turned
North along Woochang Road to Chapoo Road, after which
she returned back to the room and noticed the deceased
being lifted from the bed by his wife, who placed him on
the floor, this being the position in which he was found
by the undersigned.

At the time this murder was committed, deceased's
wife Lieu Shu Sz (劉許氏) and mother-in-law Shu-Tsu-Sa
(許朱氏), were the only other persons in the room, but
as they were also asleep when the murderer entered the
room, being only awakened by the gun report, they are
unable to give investigating officers any useful informa-
tion they only having caught a fleeting glimpse of the
assailant as he fled from the room.

Deceased's wife when further questioned denied
that her husband was connected with any Political
page_data.zh:
听到回答后，凶手进入死者房间，佣人紧随其后，并表示她要叫醒主人，但被现已潜逃的凶手阻止，凶手表示他自己会叫醒他。

一进房间，凶手就将带来的水果和糕点礼物放在桌上，然后走向床头， ostensibly 为了叫醒熟睡的人，但走到床边并未叫醒他们，凶手突然从长袍中掏出一把左轮手枪，抵住向右侧躺着的死者的左耳，向其头部开了一枪，随后匆忙逃离房间，从来时的入口成功逃脱。

佣人阿金（Ah Kying）没有试图阻止凶手，但她追着他下楼进入弄堂，注意到他沿武昌路向北转至乍浦路（Chapoo Road），之后她返回房间，注意到死者被其妻子从床上抬起，放在地板上，这正是本人发现他时的姿势。

谋杀发生时，死者的妻子刘许氏（Lieu Shu Sz）和岳母许朱氏（Shu-Tsu-Sa）是房间里仅有的其他人，但由于凶手进入房间时她们也在睡觉，仅被枪声惊醒，因此无法向调查人员提供任何有用信息，她们只在袭击者逃离房间时瞥见了他一眼。

死者的妻子在接受进一步询问时否认其丈夫与任何政治

page_data.en:
gives added weight to the belief that the murderer
had travelled from the French Concession this a.m.,
the tram ticket having been found in the basket of
fruit left behind by the murderer.
Body of the deceased now removed to Mortuary
pending inquest to be held on the 16/9/40.
Enquiries proceeding.
Circulated.
D.O. "C" Division informed and attended.

（签名）
Sen. Det. 1/c.

W. G. Smith
D.S.I.

死者尸体现已移至殓房，等待于1940年9月16日举行的死因研讯。
调查正在进行中。
已通缉。

page_data.en:
Wong Ah Kying (王阿京)。

Kompo.
Hongkew Stn.        15/9/40        translated        Clerk Caho.
                                   ----------

My name is Wong Ah Kying, age 17 yrs., native of
Kompo, S/amah, residing at House No.? West Ming Tuh Li, Rue
Brenier de Montmorand, F.C. the home of my father-in-law,
one named Wong Tsung Yang (王春楊), a public ricsha coolie.
    For the past three days, I was working as an amah
at House No.6, Lane 360, Woochang Road, through the intro-
duction of one named Ah Mei (阿梅), also an amah, in the
employ of my mistress's mother residing in F.C.
    At about 7.15 this morning (15/9/40) I left my
bed, and went into the upstairs left front room, in which
my mistress resides, to clean the furnitures and the floor,
after which, I went to the rear room to brush my hair.
    At about 9 a.m. even date, there came a male
Chinese, clad in a blue long gown, the material of which
is silk or cotton, I do not know, carrying two boxes of
moon cakes in his left hand and speaking Shanghai dialect,
inquired of the chief tenant about in which room Mr. Liu,
resides (now the victim) and the latter replied that Mr. Liu
resides in the upstairs left front room. Immediately the man
entered the said room via the open door, Placing the gifts
in question on the table and approaching the head of the bed,
on which Mr. Liu was sleeping, the man produced a pistol,
placed same against the left ear of my master Mr. Liu and
fired one shot. At the time of the shooting, my mistress
was soundly asleep. I attempted to awaken my master Mr. Liu,
however I was prevented from so doing by the man. After shoot-
ing, the man hurriedly decamped from the room while I chased
page_data.zh:
王阿京 (Wong Ah Kying)。

高邮。
虹口巡捕房        1940年9月15日        翻译        书记员 Caho。
                                   ----------

本人姓名王阿京，年龄17岁，籍贯江苏高邮，现居住于法租界蒙马兰路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）西明德里?号，即我公公王春杨（Wong Tsung Yang）家中，其职业为公共人力车夫。
    过去三天，经同样受雇于我女主人之母（住于法租界）的女佣阿梅（Ah Mei）介绍，我在武昌路360弄6号担任女佣。
    今天（1940年9月15日）早上约7点15分，我起床后进入楼上左前间，即我女主人居住的房间，清理家具和地板，随后我去后屋梳头。
    当天上午约9时，一名身穿蓝色长衫（材质是丝绸还是棉布我不清楚）的中国男子前来，左手提着两盒月饼，操上海话向二房东询问刘先生（即现在的受害者）住在哪个房间，后者回答刘先生住在楼上左前间。该男子随即通过敞开的房门进入上述房间，将所携礼物放在桌上，并走近刘先生正在睡觉的床头，掏出一把手枪，抵住我的雇主刘先生的左耳开了一枪。枪响时，我的女主人正熟睡。我试图唤醒我的雇主刘先生，但被该男子阻止。开枪后，该男子匆忙逃离房间，我追赶

page_data.en:
- 2 -

him down the stairs to the rear door, when I noticed another
male Chinese wearing white short jacket and black pants,
standing outside the rear door, shaking his hand to me and
warning me not to raise any alarm. I, in consequence, dared
not chase the man any further.

The above is my true statement.

Signed and finger-printed:-

Wong Ah Kyng.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

他下楼至后门，此时我注意到另一名身穿白色短上衣和黑裤的中国男子站在后门外，向我挥手并警告我不要声张。因此，我不敢再追。

以上是我的真实陈述。

签名并按指印：-

王阿京 (Wong Ah Kyng)。

page_data.en:
Chen Lai Sz
Canton.
Hongkew Stn. 15/9/40 translated Clerk Chen.
----------

My name is Chen Lai, Sz, age 45, residing at House No.6,
Lane 360 Woochang Road.
At 8/7/40, a man named Lieu, native of Szechuen with
his wife came to rent the front wing room of my premises.
The rent being for $20.50 per month. Lieu says he is employed
by a Japanese bank, situated at the Bund. At about 11 a.m.
every day he went out and came back at the noon. He is seldom
to go out in the afternoon. One or two male Chinese called
on Lieu every day and he closed the room door whole day, I
know nothing about Lieu's behaviour.
At about 9.45 a.m. 15/9/40, I suddenly heard a cracker
fired, I though children playing on outside the street.
Whilst Lieu's wife shouted for help and I proceeded to see
what happened and found Lieu received injuries and the
assailant already escaped.
The above is my true statement.
(Sd) Chen Lai Sz.
page_data.zh:
陈来司 (Chen Lai Sz)
广东。
虹口巡捕房 1940年9月15日 翻译 书记员 Chen。
----------

本人姓名陈来司，年龄45岁，居住于武昌路360弄6号。
1940年7月8日，一名姓刘的四川人携其妻子来租用我处的前厢房。租金为每月20.50元。刘称其受雇于外滩的一家日本银行。他每天上午约11点外出，中午回来。下午很少外出。每天有一两名中国男子拜访刘某，他整天关闭房门，我对刘某的行为一无所知。
1940年9月15日上午约9点45分，我突然听到一声爆竹响，我以为是孩子们在街外玩耍。随后刘的妻子呼救，我前去查看发生了什么事，发现刘某受伤，袭击者已逃脱。
以上是我的真实陈述。
(签名) 陈来司。

page_data.en:
Lieu Shu Sz
Zangchow.
Hongker Stn. 15/9/40 translated Clerk Ling.

My name is Lieu Shu Sz, aged 26 yrs., native of
Zangchow, /female, residing at No.6, Lane 360 off Woochang Rd.
At 9.10 a.m. on the 15/9/40, whilst I was sleeping
on my bed together with my husband named Lieu Ying and my mother
Shu Tsu Sz in the same upstairs front room, I was suddenly awaken
by the sound of a gun-shot, meanwhile I observed the head of my
husband being wounded by the bullet, bleeding profusely. I did
not see the murderer as he had already decamped. Later, the
chief tenant of the house summoned through telephone an ambulance
to arrive and have my husband conveyed to the Shanghai Sanitarium
Clinic, who had died on arrival.
Formerly my husband had served in a certain Doctrine
Regiment Association and following the present Sino-Japanese
hostilities, worked in the "Zung Chi Dong" Refugee Association,
and until last year, was employed as a broker by the Yong Hwa
Cloth Hong, a Japanese concern, located in the upstairs of the
Yokohama Specie Bank Building, The Bund.
My late husband had no enemy during his life-time
and the reason of his being murdered I do not know.
The above is my true statement.

Signed by Lieu Shu Sz.
page_data.zh:
刘舒氏 (Lieu Shu Sz)
常州。
虹口巡捕房 1940年9月15日 翻译 书记员 Ling。

本人姓名刘舒氏，年龄26岁，籍贯常州，女性，居住于武昌路360弄6号。
1940年9月15日上午9点10分，当我与丈夫刘英及母亲舒祖氏在楼上同一前间床上睡觉时，突然被枪声惊醒，同时我看到丈夫头部中弹，血流不止。我没有看到凶手，因为他已经逃跑。后来，房屋的二房东通过电话叫来救护车，将我丈夫送往上海疗养院诊所，他在抵达时死亡。
此前，我丈夫曾在某教导团服役，在中日敌对行动开始后，在“众志东”难民协会工作，直到去年，受雇于位于外滩横滨正金银行大楼楼上的日本商号永华布行，担任经纪人。
我亡夫生前没有仇敌，我不知道他被谋杀的原因。
以上是我的真实陈述。

刘舒氏签名。

page_data.en:
Shu Tsu Sz
Zangchow.
Hongkw Stn. 15/9/40. translated Clerk Ling.

My name is Shu Tsu Sz, aged 51 yrs., native of
Zangchow, S/I male, residing No.116 Rue Bourgeat F.C.
At 9.15 a.m. on the 15/9/40, whilst I was sleeping on
the floor of the upstair front room, the home of my son-in-law
named Lieu V. g (No.6/100 Booc. ang Rd,) I was suddenly awoken
by the sound of a gun-shot. At the time I saw my son-in-law
Lieu Ying's head being wounded by the bullet, whilst the
murderer ran away from side of me, however I did not see the
culprit clearly.
The above is my true statement.

Signed by Shu Tsu Sz.
page_data.zh:
舒祖氏 (Shu Tsu Sz)
常州。
虹口巡捕房 1940年9月15日。翻译 书记员 Ling。

本人姓名舒祖氏，年龄51岁，籍贯江苏常州，男性（原文如此），居住于法租界蒲石路（Rue Bourgeat）116号。
1940年9月15日上午9点15分，当我在我女婿刘V. g（原文不清，地址似为武昌路...号）家（武昌路...弄6/100号，原文不清）的楼上前间地板上睡觉时，突然被枪声惊醒。当时我看到女婿刘英头部中弹，而凶手从我身边跑过，但我没有看清罪犯的样子。
以上是我的真实陈述。

舒祖氏签名。

page_data.en:
List of documents found at the home of LIU YING (劉英)
who was assassinated on September 15, 1940 at Lane 360,
House 6, Woochang Road.

1. Political Intelligence reports - spare copies for
the months of July, August, September, October,
November and December, 1939; and also for the
months of January, February, March, April, May,
June and July, 1940.

2. Seven books containing a variety of intelligence
reports, mostly on the Secret Service of the National
Government at Chungking and its activities in Shanghai.

3. Two bundles of loose sheets - intelligence.

4. Seven exercise books containing a large quantity of
newspaper clippings.

5. Two books containing general intelligence.

6. One paper folder containing a certificate issued to
Liu Ying on 12/8/the 15th year of the Emperor Chao Woo
of Japan, by the Japanese Military Authorities.

7. One small note book containing names, addresses and
telephone numbers of different persons.

8. Seven bundles of drafts - intelligence.

9. One note book containing the local addresses of important
personnel and high officials of the National Government
at Chungking.

10. 21 sheets of typewritten paper (in French), mostly on
the following subjects:-
a) The attempted assassination of M. Blanchet, Acting
Commissioner of the French Police.
b) M. Auge, local Consul-General for France, dismissed
by the Vichy Government.
c) Adoption of precautionary measures in the French
Concession.
d) Anti-British Movement to be commenced in the French
Concession.
e) Political Plain Clothes Squads to be organized by
the Political Section of the French Police.

11. One certificate issued on August 12, the 15th year of
the Emperor Chao Woo of Japan to one LI HUNG DOO (李宏圖),
aged 27, residing in the Che Yung University, Wangkashaw
Gardens, (Intelligence Worker) by the Japanese Military
Authorities.

12. Day to day record on the political situation in China
from January 1, 1940 to June 30, 1940.

13. A bundle of drafts, miscellaneous papers, name cards,
invitation cards, etc..

14. One envelop containing $30.00 in legal tender notes.
..........
page_data.zh:
1940年9月15日在武昌路360弄6号被暗杀的刘英（LIU YING）家中发现的文件清单。

1. 政治情报报告——1939年7月、8月、9月、10月、11月和12月的备用副本；以及1940年1月、2月、3月、4月、5月、6月和7月的备用副本。

2. 七本书，包含各种情报报告，主要关于重庆国民政府的情报部门及其在上海的活动。

3. 两捆散页——情报资料。

4. 七本练习簿，包含大量剪报。

5. 两本书，包含一般情报。

6. 一个纸质文件夹，内含一份由日本军方当局于日本昭和天皇十五年8月12日签发给刘英的证书。

7. 一个小笔记本，包含不同人员的姓名、地址和电话号码。

8. 七捆草稿——情报资料。

9. 一个笔记本，包含重庆国民政府重要人员和高官的本地地址。

10. 21页打字纸（法文），主要涉及以下主题：-
a) 法国警务处代理总监 Blanchet 先生遇刺未遂案。
b) 法国驻沪总领事 Auge 先生被维希政府免职。
c) 在法租界采取预防措施。
d) 将在法租界发起的反英运动。
e) 由法国警务处政治科组织的政治便衣队。

11. 一份由日本军方当局于日本昭和天皇十五年8月12日签发给李宏圖（LI HUNG DOO）的证书，李宏圖，27岁，居住于王家沙花园之震旦大学，（情报工作人员）。

12. 1940年1月1日至1940年6月30日中国政局逐日记录。

13. 一捆草稿、杂项文件、名片、请柬等。

14. 一个信封，内合法币30.00元。
